_comment: GCS lifecycle for proton call recordings + transcripts.
9 Nov 2026: NO automatic deletion. The former 90-day Delete rule was removed
from the live bucket, because Proton's RFP 2026_028 section 4.84 asks for all
operations data to be kept for at least 7 years and 90 days was only our
default. Whether call recordings fall under the 7 years (or a shorter PDPA
period) is an open question to Proton; set a rule here once they answer.
The old rule is kept below under _former_rule for reference.
If a rule is ever re-added: matchesPrefix is LOAD-BEARING. gs://lv-playground-genai
is a SHARED bucket -- it also holds bqml/, which belongs to unrelated work. A
rule without the prefix condition applies to the WHOLE bucket. Never remove or
widen the prefix. retention.py cannot enforce PHONE_RECORDING_RETENTION_DAYS
(there is no Twilio recording-delete adapter), and the Twilio-side copies are
NOT covered by any rule here -- it governs only the archived copies in this
(an empty rule list clears the bucket's lifecycle configuration)
